pages.text: Don't rush to launch yet. To successfully reach space, you need to fill up the rocket with fuel.

pages.title: get fuel
pages.text: There are many oil springs on the sea surface. Oil is a non-renewable resource, and in the game you need to collect as much of it as possible. The Rockets are a big powerhouse.

pages.title: get fuel
pages.text: After collecting at least 6 barrels of oil (which is enough for a rocket round trip), you need to refine them into fuel. The refining process needs to be carried out in a fuel refiner. Turn on the power, put the oil in from the left side, and start refining.

pages.title: fuel refiner
pages.text: While sneaking, left-click the rocket to open its inventory, then place three barrels of fuel in the input field. If you don't want to take a trip that never comes back, you'd better take three more barrels of fuel with you.
